news.titleEn: Fed’s preferred gauge showed core inflation at 3.0% in August, much lighter than expected
news.conclusionEn: U.S. PCE inflation cooled to 3.4% headline and 3.0% core in August, both well below forecasts.
news.conclusionZh: 美国8月PCE通胀降至3.4%，核心3.0%，均低于预期
news.whyEn: It is the Fed's main inflation gauge, so a softer reading lowers the odds of another rate hike in October and moves bond and stock markets.
news.whyZh: 这是美联储最看重的通胀指标，降温降低了10月加息概率，直接影响股债市场
news.detailEn: Headline PCE fell from 3.7% in July to 3.4%, while core eased from 3.3% to 3.0%, against economists' expectations of no change. Energy was still the main driver of price gains, with gasoline up 4.4% in the month amid the Middle East war. Part of the improvement reflects the BEA's annual methodology changes rather than pure price cooling. Traders cut the odds of an October hike to roughly 35%, but inflation remains well above the Fed's 2% target, keeping a December hike in play.
news.detailZh: 8月整体PCE从7月的3.7%降至3.4%，核心PCE从3.3%降至3.0%，而经济学家原本预计持平。能源仍是主要推手，受中东战争影响汽油当月上涨4.4%。部分降幅来自美国经济分析局的年度统计方法调整，并非完全是物价降温。交易员把10月加息概率降到约35%，但通胀仍远高于2%目标，12月加息的可能性依然存在。

news.titleEn: Oil prices rise on stalled US-Iran talks and tight fuel markets
news.conclusionEn: Brent crude ended September up more than 14% after Trump denied he would ease sanctions on Iran and peace talks stalled.
news.conclusionZh: 美伊谈判停滞，布伦特原油9月累计涨超14%
news.whyEn: Oil near $100 feeds directly into global inflation, central bank decisions and costs for airlines, shippers and consumers.
news.whyZh: 油价逼近100美元直接推高全球通胀，影响央行决策和航空、物流及消费者成本
news.detailEn: The expiring Brent November contract rose about 1% to settle at $103.53 a barrel on Wednesday, while WTI gained more than 5% over the month. Prices climbed after Trump denied he was willing to ease Iran sanctions, even as Qatar continued mediating and Iran said it received a U.S. counterproposal to its seven-day Strait of Hormuz plan. Partly offsetting the rally, Middle East exports are recovering, including Saudi shipments from Yanbu. Any breakthrough or collapse in the talks could swing prices sharply in either direction.
news.detailZh: 即将到期的布伦特11月合约周三上涨约1%，收于每桶103.53美元，WTI当月涨幅也超过5%。特朗普否认愿意放宽对伊朗制裁后油价走高，与此同时卡塔尔仍在斡旋，伊朗表示已收到美方对其「七天重开霍尔木兹海峡」方案的反提案。中东出口有所恢复（包括沙特延布港重启出口），部分抵消了涨势。谈判一旦突破或破裂，油价都可能大幅波动。

news.titleEn: Fed’s Williams Sees One More Interest Rate Hike in Late 2026
news.conclusionEn: New York Fed President John Williams said there is no urgency for an October hike, but one more increase may be appropriate late this year.
news.conclusionZh: 纽约联储主席威廉姆斯称10月无需急于加息，年底或再加一次
news.whyEn: As the Fed's No. 2 policymaker, Williams' signal reshapes market expectations for rates, bond yields and the dollar.
news.whyZh: 他是美联储二号决策人物，其表态直接改变市场对利率、美债收益率和美元的预期
news.detailEn: Williams said that after the Fed's September hike, policymakers have time to gather more information before acting again. His remarks pushed many forecasters, including Goldman Sachs, to conclude an October move is unlikely and December is the more probable timing. The Fed's latest dot plot still points to at least one more hike this year due to sticky inflation. Friday's jobs report will be the next key test for that path.
news.detailZh: 威廉姆斯表示，美联储9月已加息，现在有时间收集更多信息再行动。他的讲话让高盛等多家机构判断10月加息可能性不大，12月更可能出手。美联储最新点阵图仍显示，由于通胀黏性，今年至少还会再加息一次。周五的非农就业报告将是下一个关键考验。

news.conclusionEn: Micron posted record quarterly revenue of $54.2 billion, beating estimates, and guided well above expectations on AI memory demand.
news.conclusionZh: 美光季度营收创纪录达542亿美元，指引大超预期
news.whyEn: Micron is a bellwether for AI hardware spending; its results signal how strong data-center demand remains for chips and memory.
news.whyZh: 美光是AI硬件支出的风向标，业绩反映数据中心对芯片和内存需求的强度
news.detailEn: Fiscal fourth-quarter adjusted EPS was $33.42 versus the $31.61 expected, on revenue of $54.23 billion versus $51.07 billion estimated. DRAM revenue jumped 343% year over year to $39.8 billion, about 73% of total sales, as AI servers soak up high-bandwidth memory. For the current quarter, Micron guided to about $61.5 billion in revenue and $38.15 adjusted EPS, far above consensus. The results reinforce the memory 'supercycle' narrative but also raise questions about how long such extreme pricing can last.
news.detailZh: 第四财季调整后每股收益33.42美元，高于预期的31.61美元；营收542.3亿美元，高于预期的510.7亿美元。DRAM营收同比暴增343%至398亿美元，约占总营收73%，主要受AI服务器对高带宽内存的需求推动。美光预计本季度营收约615亿美元、调整后每股收益38.15美元，远超市场预期。这份财报强化了「内存超级周期」的说法，但也让人关注如此高的价格还能持续多久。

news.titleEn: US Companies Added 90,000 Jobs in September, ADP Data Shows
news.conclusionEn: U.S. private employers added 90,000 jobs in September, well above forecasts and up from a revised 36,000 in August.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月ADP私营就业增9万人，明显好于预期
news.whyEn: A stronger labor market can keep inflation pressure alive, partly offsetting the soft PCE report in the Fed's calculus.
news.whyZh: 就业强劲可能维持通胀压力，部分抵消PCE降温对美联储的影响
news.detailEn: Economists had expected around 70,000 new private-sector jobs. Education and health services led hiring with 55,000 positions, followed by leisure and hospitality, manufacturing and construction. Pay for job-stayers rose 3.2% from a year earlier. The data tempered the market rally from the inflation report, and attention now turns to the official payrolls report due Friday.
news.detailZh: 经济学家原本预计私营部门新增约7万个岗位。教育和医疗服务业贡献最多，新增5.5万个，其次是休闲酒店、制造业和建筑业。在职员工薪资同比上涨3.2%。这份数据削弱了通胀报告带来的市场涨势，市场焦点转向周五公布的官方非农就业报告。

news.titleEn: S&P 500 falls Wednesday despite softer-than-expected inflation data; index posts losing September: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: The S&P 500 slipped 0.25% to 7,651.54 on the last day of the quarter, capping its worst month since June.
news.conclusionZh: 标普500季末收跌0.25%，录得6月以来最差月份
news.whyEn: A losing September shows how rising bond yields and rate-hike fears are weighing on equities despite strong AI earnings.
news.whyZh: 9月下跌说明尽管AI业绩强劲，美债收益率上升和加息担忧仍在压制股市
news.detailEn: Stocks rose as much as 0.7% after the cooler PCE report but faded as the strong ADP data and elevated Treasury yields revived rate concerns. The Nasdaq Composite bucked the trend, rising 0.24% to 26,861.06 ahead of Micron's results. Long-term Treasury yields have recently hit multi-decade highs on inflation and oil worries. Investors enter the fourth quarter focused on Friday's jobs report and the Fed's next move.
news.detailZh: PCE数据公布后股市一度上涨0.7%，但强劲的ADP数据和高企的美债收益率重新引发利率担忧，涨幅回吐。纳斯达克综合指数逆势上涨0.24%，收于26861.06点，市场等待美光财报。受通胀和油价担忧影响，长期美债收益率近期升至数十年高位。进入第四季度，投资者关注周五的就业报告和美联储下一步动作。

news.titleEn: OpenAI Targets $30 Billion in New Funding Round
news.conclusionEn: OpenAI is seeking at least $30 billion in new funding at a valuation of around $1.4 trillion, as a bridge to a delayed IPO.
news.conclusionZh: OpenAI拟以约1.4万亿美元估值融资至少300亿美元
news.whyEn: It would be one of the largest private raises ever and sets a benchmark for AI valuations as rival Anthropic moves toward an IPO.
news.whyZh: 这将是史上最大私募融资之一，为AI估值树立标杆，正值对手Anthropic推进IPO
news.detailEn: Talks are at an early stage and terms could change, according to Bloomberg. OpenAI was valued at $852 billion in a March round, so the new target implies a sharp markup. CEO Sam Altman has said the company will not go public in 2026, making private capital its main funding route for massive compute spending. The company's annualized revenue run rate is reported to be nearing $70 billion.
news.detailZh: 据彭博报道，谈判尚处于早期阶段，条款可能变化。OpenAI在3月一轮融资中估值为8520亿美元，新目标意味着大幅上调。CEO奥尔特曼此前表示公司2026年不会上市，因此私募资金成为支撑巨额算力投入的主要渠道。据报道，公司年化营收已接近700亿美元。

news.titleEn: Trump's latest global tariffs face trade court challenge
news.conclusionEn: A U.S. trade court heard a challenge to Trump's Section 301 'forced labor' tariffs covering 99.4% of U.S. imports.
news.conclusionZh: 美国贸易法院审理特朗普覆盖99.4%进口的「强迫劳动」关税诉讼
news.whyEn: The ruling could decide whether sweeping tariffs on 86 countries stand, affecting import costs, supply chains and trading partners.
news.whyZh: 判决将决定对86国的全面关税能否维持，影响进口成本、供应链和贸易伙伴
news.detailEn: A three-judge panel at the Court of International Trade heard arguments from small businesses and Democratic-led states that the 10% to 12.5% tariffs overstep the law. It is the third time in under two years courts have been asked to block Trump's broad tariffs. In February the Supreme Court struck down most of his tariffs imposed under emergency economic powers, prompting the administration to switch legal authorities. A loss could force refunds and another policy rethink.
news.detailZh: 国际贸易法院三名法官组成的合议庭听取了小企业和民主党执政州的论点，他们认为10%至12.5%的关税超越了法律授权。这是不到两年内法院第三次被要求阻止特朗普的大范围关税。今年2月最高法院已裁定其依据紧急经济权力加征的大部分关税违法，政府随后改用其他法律依据。若再次败诉，可能需要退还关税并重新调整政策。

news.titleEn: BOJ Tankan shows sixth straight rise in manufacturer sentiment
news.conclusionEn: Japan's large manufacturers' sentiment rose to +24 in Q3, the sixth straight improvement, driven by AI-related demand.
news.conclusionZh: 日本大型制造业信心升至+24，连续六个季度改善
news.whyEn: Solid business confidence and high inflation expectations strengthen the case for further Bank of Japan rate hikes, moving the yen.
news.whyZh: 企业信心稳健、通胀预期偏高，强化日本央行继续加息的理由，影响日元走势
news.detailEn: The headline index rose from +22 in June to +24, slightly below the +25 forecast, while large non-manufacturers slipped to +35. Robust global AI investment is supporting exports even as Middle East tensions push up energy costs. Firms expect inflation to stay around 2.5% to 2.6% over the next three to five years, above the BOJ's 2% target. The Nikkei rose nearly 2% on Thursday morning.
news.detailZh: 大型制造业指数从6月的+22升至+24，略低于预期的+25；大型非制造业指数降至+35。尽管中东局势推高能源成本，全球AI投资热潮支撑了日本出口需求。企业预计未来3到5年通胀维持在2.5%至2.6%左右，高于日本央行2%的目标。周四上午日经指数上涨近2%。

news.titleEn: Russia pounds Ukraine with missiles and drones, killing 7 and targeting power grid, Zelenskyy says
news.conclusionEn: Russian missile and drone strikes killed seven people in Ukraine and hit the power grid, including in Kyiv.
news.conclusionZh: 俄罗斯导弹无人机袭击乌克兰致7死，重点打击电网
news.whyEn: Escalating attacks on energy infrastructure ahead of winter deepen the humanitarian crisis and keep Europe's security risks high.
news.whyZh: 入冬前能源设施遭密集打击，加剧人道危机，欧洲安全风险持续高企
news.detailEn: Ballistic missile explosions rocked Kyiv overnight and disrupted electricity in parts of the capital. Moscow has sharply escalated its aerial campaign since late August, a pattern seen in previous winters aimed at cutting heat and power. On the ground, Russian forces made only small net territorial gains in September. Ukraine continues to seek more air defense, with Belgium pledging three F-16s by year-end.
news.detailZh: 夜间基辅发生弹道导弹爆炸，首都部分地区停电。自8月底以来俄方大幅升级空袭，延续了往年冬季切断供暖和电力的打法。地面战场上，俄军9月仅取得少量领土净推进。乌克兰继续寻求更多防空支援，比利时承诺年底前移交3架F-16战机。

businessTips.explanationEn: The sunk cost fallacy is the tendency to keep investing in a project because of what you have already spent, rather than what you expect to gain from here. Money and time already spent cannot be recovered, so they should not drive future decisions. Good managers judge each decision only on future costs and benefits. Recognizing this bias helps teams kill failing projects earlier and redeploy resources.
businessTips.explanationZh: 沉没成本谬误是指因为已经投入了很多，就继续往一个项目里砸钱，而不是看未来能得到什么。已经花掉的钱和时间无法收回，不应左右未来的决策。优秀的管理者只根据未来的成本和收益来做判断。认识这种偏差，能帮助团队更早砍掉失败项目，把资源投到更好的地方。
businessTips.exampleEn: A company has spent $2 million on a software system that still doesn't work and needs another $1 million. If buying a proven off-the-shelf tool costs $300,000, the rational choice is to switch, regardless of the $2 million already spent.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家公司已在某个软件系统上花了200万美元，系统仍不能用，还要再投100万。如果买一个成熟现成的工具只需30万，理性选择就是换掉，不管之前已经花了200万。

businessTips.explanationEn: Product-market fit means your product satisfies a strong demand in a specific market, so customers actively want it, keep using it and recommend it. Before PMF, the priority is learning and iterating, not scaling marketing spend. A common test is asking users how disappointed they'd be if the product disappeared; if over 40% say 'very disappointed', you're likely close. Spending heavily on growth before PMF usually burns cash fast.
businessTips.explanationZh: 产品市场契合（PMF）是指你的产品满足了某个特定市场的强烈需求，客户会主动想要、持续使用并推荐给别人。达到PMF之前，重点是学习和迭代，而不是砸钱做推广。常用的检验方法是问用户：如果这个产品消失，你会有多失望？如果超过40%的人说「非常失望」，说明你可能接近PMF了。在PMF之前大举投入增长，往往会迅速烧光资金。
businessTips.exampleEn: A side-hustle seller of digital planners notices that most buyers come from word of mouth and many repurchase each year without ads. That organic pull is a sign of PMF, so it's now worth investing in paid marketing to scale.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个卖电子手账模板的副业卖家发现，大部分买家来自口碑推荐，很多人每年不用广告也会回购。这种自然拉动就是PMF的信号，这时再投入付费推广去放大规模才划算。

businessTips.explanationEn: Cyclical stocks are companies whose earnings rise and fall sharply with the economic or industry cycle, such as memory chips, autos, airlines and commodities. Their profits can swing from big losses to record highs within a few years. A counterintuitive rule is that their P/E ratio often looks lowest at the peak of the cycle, when earnings are temporarily inflated. Investors therefore focus on where the cycle is heading rather than current earnings alone.
businessTips.explanationZh: 周期股是指盈利随经济或行业周期大幅起落的公司，比如存储芯片、汽车、航空和大宗商品。它们的利润可能在几年内从巨亏变成创纪录高位。一个反直觉的规律是：在周期顶部，盈利被暂时推高，市盈率反而看起来最低。所以投资者更关注周期接下来的走向，而不只是看当前盈利。
businessTips.exampleEn: Micron's revenue more than tripled in a year as AI demand drove up memory prices, making its P/E look cheap. But memory history shows prices can collapse once new supply comes online, so investors watch capacity expansion and pricing trends closely.
businessTips.exampleZh: 受AI需求推高内存价格影响，美光营收一年内增长了两倍多，市盈率看起来很便宜。但存储行业历史表明，一旦新产能释放，价格可能暴跌，所以投资者会密切关注产能扩张和价格走势。
